Open the application link given in the notice: https://forms.gle/53LozQnQhxrsU1Un9.

Pay the application fee of INR 500 + GST through the payment link or QR code printed in the notice (SC/ST/PwD candidates are exempted).
Report for the walk-in interview on the date fixed for your school, at 09.30 am, at NFSU Delhi Campus, Outer Ring Rd, near Jaipur Golden Hospital, Institutional Area, Rohini, Delhi, 110085.
Carry all original documents and the online fee transaction receipt to the interview.

There shall not be any separate intimation for interviews by telephone or email. All candidates fulfilling the eligibility criteria need to report on the interview dates with all supporting documents. A candidate is allowed to appear before the interview panel only subject to fulfilment of the eligibility criteria. Depending on the number of candidates, interviews may go till late in the day or may be conducted on the subsequent day, and candidates are required to make their arrangements accordingly. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
The fee is paid online through the payment link and QR code given in the notice. Candidates are requested to bring the online transaction receipt at the time of the walk-in interview.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: All posts carry a consolidated fixed monthly remuneration, as printed below. The remuneration list does not include the Associate Professor posts; the notice does not mention their pay. In case qualified and suitable candidates are not found for the post of Assistant Professor in any of the disciplines, the University may appoint contractual faculty at lower remuneration, either as Assistant Professor or in a Lecturer's position: Candidates having a Master degree with minimum first class or 60% or equivalent in the relevant discipline from a recognized university, with very good academic record throughout, and who have qualified the NET Exam in the relevant branch shall be considered for Assistant Professor-Lower Remuneration (contractual) at Rs. 75000/- per month. Candidates who are not NET qualified but are pursuing Ph.D from any INI or recognized University will be paid a consolidated remuneration of Rs 68000/- per month. The positions are filled purely on a contractual basis for the Delhi Campus. The terms and conditions of appointment shall be communicated in an "Offer of Appointment" to selected candidates. If a candidate does not accept them within the stipulated time, the offer shall be treated as withdrawn. The University reserves the right to offer a post at a level lower than advertised, depending on qualifications, experience and performance, and to draw reserve panel(s) against possible future vacancies. The medium of instruction for all courses in the Schools, Centres and Departments of the University shall be English.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NFSU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: NFSU Recruitment 2026 has an online application followed by a walk-in interview. The application window is open until 2 December 2026. Open the application link given in the notice: https://forms.gle/53LozQnQhxrsU1Un9 . Fill in the application and upload your eligibility documents through the same link, as the notice requests of all candidates. Pay the application fee of INR 500 + GST through the payment link or QR code printed in the notice (SC/ST/PwD candidates are exempted). Complete the application by 02.12.2026. Report for the walk-in interview on the date fixed for your school, at 09.30 am, at NFSU Delhi Campus, Outer Ring Rd, near Jaipur Golden Hospital, Institutional Area, Rohini, Delhi, 110085. Carry all original documents and the online fee transaction receipt to the interview. There shall not be any separate intimation for interviews by telephone or email. All candidates fulfilling the eligibility criteria need to report on the interview dates with all supporting documents. A candidate is allowed to appear before the interview panel only subject to fulfilment of the eligibility criteria. Depending on the number of candidates, interviews may go till late in the day or may be conducted on the subsequent day, and candidates are required to make their arrangements accordingly. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. The fee is paid online through the payment link and QR code given in the notice. Candidates are requested to bring the online transaction receipt at the time of the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NFSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notice lists 42 contractual posts at the NFSU Delhi Campus: 2 Associate Professor, 29 Assistant Professor, 3 JSO, 5 SSA and 3 Laboratory Assistant posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NFSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply through the online link is 2 December 2026 (02.12.2026).

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for NFSU Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is a Ph.D. in relevant/allied discipline with first class in preceding degree; experience in the relevant field and one SCI journal publication are desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for NFSU JSO, SSA and LA posts?
faq.answer: JSO candidates must not be more than 35 years of age, and SSA and LA candidates must not be more than 30 years. For JSO and SSA, the upper age limit does not apply to candidates in the service of State or Central Government/University/Board/Corporation.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of NFSU Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: An Assistant Professor with Ph.D. gets a consolidated fixed monthly remuneration of Rs. 90,000/-, and an Assistant Professor UGC NET Qualified gets Rs. 75,000/-. JSO gets Rs. 60,200/-, SSA Rs. 47,400/- and LA Rs. 34,200/-.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for NFSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is INR 500 + GST, paid online; SC/ST/PwD candidates are exempted. The transaction receipt must be brought to the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for NFSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply and upload eligibility documents through the link https://forms.gle/53LozQnQhxrsU1Un9 by 2 December 2026, then report for the walk-in interview at NFSU Delhi Campus, Rohini, at 09.30 am on your school's date.

faq.question: Q8. When is the NFSU Delhi Campus walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Interviews are on 12 December 2026 (School of Management / School of Law), 13 December 2026 (School of Forensic Science) and 14 December 2026 (School of Cyber Security & Digital Forensics / School of Behavioral Forensic). The schedule for JSO, SSA and LA posts shall be communicated shortly.

faq.question: Q9. Are NFSU Recruitment 2026 posts permanent?
faq.answer: No. The University is filling these positions purely on a contractual basis for its Delhi Campus.

faq.question: Q10. Is RCI registration required for NFSU Assistant Professor (Clinical Psychology)?
faq.answer: Yes, for one vacancy under RCI, the registration as Clinical Psychologist under RCI Act is mandatory.
